review.identity: mimo-1 (opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-flash), implementer-run re-measurement; independent reviewer per Rally
review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability, cross-checked here by recomputing every campaign mission's closure with the production catalog builder and closure walker (the code the cs-inspect closure CLI runs) and re-measuring the cold/warm/restart cycle through the production store over the mounted original installation. Every field is derived from the recorded log, that independent re-measurement, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, rustc and Cargo.lock; nothing is typed in by hand, and a failing run would produce a report the validator rejects. SCOPE OF THIS MEASUREMENT, so no reader mistakes it for a fidelity claim: (1) the measured closure is each campaign mission's dependency closure as the production catalog and closure walker compute it — on this installation every mission closure reaches exactly its mission row, its reader-archive program row and the install-file row, one unique byte source per mission — and the derived asset is the archive's structural member listing decoded through the production F06 dispatch → trailer index → reader-archive pipeline, not a member-content interpretation or an original-engine derived format; (2) no reached closure member has a runtime consumer and none is catalog-ready, so nothing here is `verified_original` and the per-node accounting of served and not-served members is carried in full in the cycle.json artifact and in docs/findings; those are measured facts of today's product state with their resolving tasks named there, not unresolved issues inside F15-E's own scope, which is why `unknowns` is empty. The claim is `implemented`, and it gates no fidelity or release statement. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
